name: Ribbon Trail
description: Inside its area the pointer draws a ribbon of silk that follows it, turns over as it curves, and comes to rest.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the face of the ribbon. Any CSS colour or token. At night the ribbon also gives off a faint glow in this colour.

props.name: underside
props.description: Colour of the underside, seen where the ribbon has turned over. Defaults to a pale tint of color.

props.name: length
props.description: Length of the ribbon in pixels.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the ribbon at the head in pixels. It tapers to a point at the tail and narrows where it twists.

props.name: gravity
props.description: How strongly the ribbon is pulled down. It hangs from the pointer when the pointer stops, and falls away when the pointer leaves. 0 lets it float.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the area. The ribbon is drawn above it and never takes the pointer, so links, buttons and text selection work as usual.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and sets the size of the area. It allows vertical scrolling by touch, so a sideways drag draws and an upward or downward one scrolls the page; add touch-none to draw in every direction. Other div props, including ref, are passed through.
